items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Sidney wilson the trombone player was a very fine pianist

ctx.x: did you have many piano players in the early days with bands

no it was difficult to have piano players because the piano that you'd find in the home there were usually two and three two one to two tones under international pitch never in tune and for that reason you couldn't play at such a time when we did have pianists regus would play for us or walter ross he was the piano player around new orleans at that time well who were some of the outstanding pianists then well they were joe wolf i would say he was a young man too and uh Sidney wilson the trombone player was a very…
I still see Erwin LeClaire around there he's yes he's a very nice fellow I like his tune triangle jazz blues
